verdict.rationale: CrewAI agents and tasks are defined via natural-language role/goal/description fields that the agent then autonomously interprets and acts on (docs-2, docs-33, docs-46, docs-61), and CrewAI ships setup prompts for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to operate it via natural language (docs-58). However, the actual operational surface for a human user (the CLI, YAML config, Python API) is fixed-syntax, not a natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: no evidence of a chat/NL interface for invoking or controlling crews directly, and CLI commands (create/train/run/test) are rigid, not NL-parsed.
